featurebullets: About this item CONVENIENT MICROWAVE: Prepare quick and easy meals in a snap with our powerful microwave. It packs 700 of output power and features a range of settings for press-and-go speed. POWERFUL SETTINGS: This microwave has ten power levels with multi-stage cooking. You can fully customize your cooking with six one-touch options, including popcorn, potato, and pizza. Defrost by weight or by time settings to make quick work of any task. PERFECT SIZE: Measuring 0.7 cu ft, this microwave is the ideal small-space solution that offers full-sized cooking in a compact space. It features an easy-to-clean interior and exterior and is perfect for the home or office. ALL YOU NEED: This microwave has a clear LED display with a kitchen timer and clock that lets you easily keep track of time. Easy-to-view interior lighting lets you keep an eye on your dish, and a child safety lock adds additional security. FARBERWARE: From weeknight favorites to family feasts they'll never forget, Farberware helps today's families craft the meals that make memories and bring everyone together. › See more product details

desc: This microwave oven is the ideal size for office break rooms or home kitchens. One-touch cooking programs let you cook six of the most popular food items with the touch of a button. Choose from ten power levels up to 700. The large digital screen has a clock feature and can display a countdown timer in addition to the remaining cook time. The memory function lets you customize and save your favorite settings, and the large door has an easy-grip handle and child-safety lock.
